_note: How readers meet each chart form, and which jobs it does. Read by skills/chart-choice and by qa/lint_code.mjs (check 'choice'). Tiers: familiar = any newspaper reader reads it without help (use freely); learnable = readable once the chart says what a mark is (needs an explanation box); specialist = a form most readers have never seen (needs an explanation box and a written reason why no familiar form makes the point). A chart file opens with a choice record: // Choice: claim "..." | job <job> | form <template>[, <fallback>] | tier <tier> [| not <familiar form>: <reason>]

jobs.record: X is the highest / lowest since ...
jobs.amounts: how much each period (growth, flows, annual returns), often ±
jobs.decomposition: what moved a total from P to Q
jobs.composition: what a total is made of, over time
jobs.ranking: who is highest / lowest of a set
jobs.outcome-range: worst, middle and best per group
jobs.rank-change: rank or level moved between dates
jobs.relationship: two measures for the same items
jobs.curve: a curve on a non-time axis (yield curve)
jobs.part-to-whole: X is N% of the whole
jobs.range: now against the range of the past
